summary.text: Erica Moore is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 15 and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gov. Jim Justice appointed her to the seat on November 6, 2023, to replace Riley Keaton.

paragraphs.text: Erica Moore was born in Parkersburg, West Virginia, and earned a degree in computer science from West Virginia University in 1991.
Her career experience includes working in accounting, as an office administrator and in app development, and she was the clerk for the Water and Sewer Department of Spencer, West Virginia.
